name: augi-ui
description: augi-ui, the OpenAugi pane beside your agent chat: anchor on a Kanban project or task, tell the chat which note it is on, pin its context (notes, sessions, artifacts, links), keep this week's note and its workstreams in view, sync the week and the board from them, close out finished work, run lenses, and keep an Agent Log section in each anchor's note. Drafts only; you press enter.

notesFolder.title: Notes folder
notesFolder.description: The folder that holds your markdown notes (an Obsidian vault or any folder). An absolute path; ~ is allowed.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: What opens a note when you press it in the pane. custom uses the command below.

editorCommand.title: Custom editor command
editorCommand.description: Used when the editor is custom. {file} is replaced by the note's path, e.g. zed {file}.

fileEditor.title: File editor
fileEditor.description: What opens a file that is not a note (code, docs, anything outside the notes folder) when you press it in the pane. Notes open with the editor above.

contextNote.title: Context note
contextNote.description: Who you are, your season focus and your projects, inside the notes folder. The first bold line under a heading with 'season' or 'focus' becomes your focus line.

boardNote.title: Board note
boardNote.description: A Kanban-style board inside the notes folder. Each open card that links a note can be your anchor.

lensFolder.title: Lens folder
lensFolder.description: A folder of lens notes inside the notes folder: one markdown prompt per lens.

logFolder.title: Agent log folder
logFolder.description: Where Agent Log files used to be kept. Each anchor's log is now the last section of its own note; a file found here is moved into its note once, then left alone.

dailyNote.title: Daily note
dailyNote.description: Today's note, for the pane's Today card: a path inside the notes folder with the date in it, e.g. Daily/{{date:YYYY-MM-DD}}.md. Empty reads Obsidian's own daily-note folder and format; none turns the card off.

dailyHeading.title: Daily log heading
dailyHeading.description: The heading in today's note that lines logged from the pane go under (made when missing). Empty adds them at the end of the note.

weekNote.title: Week note
weekNote.description: This week's note, shown in the pane instead of today's: a path inside the notes folder with a date in it, e.g. Weekly/{{date:YYYY-MM-DD}} - week.md. The date may be any day of the week; the pane makes Monday's. Its checkboxes under the workstream heading are the week's workstreams. Empty shows today's note.

weekHeading.title: Week workstream heading
weekHeading.description: The heading in the week's note whose checkboxes are this week's workstreams. Empty is This week.

dayHeading.title: Week day heading
dayHeading.description: The heading each day's logged lines go under in the week's note, with its level and the date in it. Empty is ### {{date:YYYY-MM-DD}}: a dated entry, the same one you write that day, which the pane finds even when you added words after the date.

taskFolder.title: Task folder
taskFolder.description: The one folder every new task note from the pane goes to, inside the notes folder. Empty puts them at the notes folder's root. Tasks are organized by their Up: link, not by folder.

taskColumn.title: New task column
taskColumn.description: The board column a new standalone task goes to when the chat has no anchor (with one, it goes to the anchor's column). The column's heading as written on the board. Empty uses the board's first column.

jiraProject.title: Jira project
jiraProject.description: Optional. The Jira project key or board your issues live in (e.g. PROJ). It is quoted into the prompts the pane drafts for finding and updating issues.

jiraSite.title: Jira site
jiraSite.description: Optional. Your Jira site's base URL (e.g. https://example.atlassian.net), used only to open a linked issue in the browser.

jiraServer.title: Jira MCP server
jiraServer.description: Optional. The Jira MCP server's name as /mcp lists it. Empty looks for a likely one (atlassian, jira). The pane never calls it; drafts name it for the chat.

lensPicks.title: Lens picks
lensPicks.description: Lens names to show, comma separated, in this order. Empty shows every lens in the lens folder.

openOnStart.title: Open with every new chat
openOnStart.description: yes opens the Augi pane when a new interactive chat starts; no keeps it closed until you type /augi.

stateLens.title: State prompt
stateLens.description: The saved prompt (a lens name) the pane asks a chat's own model to say where its work stands. Empty uses chat-state.

stateAuto.title: Update the state by itself
stateAuto.description: yes asks for a chat's state after a turn, at most every ten minutes, and offers a chat with no anchor a task once (one extra model call each time); no asks only when you press.

tellChat.title: Tell each chat its anchor
tellChat.description: yes tells a chat's own model which note it is anchored to and where in it agents write, beside your next prompt and out of your sight, so "update the task note" needs no path; no keeps the anchor in the pane only.

trackUsage.title: Count which controls I use
trackUsage.description: yes keeps a local log of which pane controls are pressed (names only, never what you typed, and it never leaves this computer); no stops it. /augi usage prints the report.

band.title: Line above the prompt
band.description: yes shows one line above the prompt with this chat's anchor and what waits on you or comes next (from its state); pressing it opens the pane. no hides it.
